title: Dipped brim hidden chin limbs swim on rims of slim pseudonyms whispering truths on the wind hymns of imposters skim the rosters of the prim and proper
summary: Dipped brim hidden chin limbs swim on rims of slim pseudonyms whispering truths on the wind hymns of imposters skim the rosters of the prim and proper #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Dipped brim
hidden chin
limbs swim
on rims
of slim
pseudonyms
  whispering
truths
  on the wind
hymns of imposters
   skim
the rosters of the
   prim and
proper
#smallpoems
